newsitem.title: USA: Texas power prices hold steady through weekend.
newsitem.headline: Texas power prices hold steady through weekend.

text.p: Wholesale electricity prices in the Electric Reliability Council of Texas (ERCOT) held steady for business through the weekend and into Monday, buoyed by strong natural gas prices, industry sources said.
Spot south Texas natural gas prices were reported to have held relatively steady Friday after Thursday's strong gains.
ERCOT firm, peak power for Saturday, Sunday and Monday were assessed steady in the $29.00-31.00 range, the brokers and marketers said.
Off-peak non-firm ERCOT power transactions for the weekend and Monday were pegged lower at $10.00-12.00 from $12.00-14.00 on Thursday with very little business being done, the sources said.

ERCOT December peak power was said to have moved upwards to near $33.00-33.75 from $32.00-33.75 on Thursday, while January/February power prices were pegged higher at $31.50-32.00 from $29.00-30.00 on Thursday, the sources said.
